notes.text: The Bachelor of Science degree program in Artificial Intelligence for Business is offered jointly by the Marshall School of Business and the Viterbi School of Engineering.
notes.source_line: The Bachelor of Science degree program in Artificial Intelligence for Business is offered jointly by the Marshall School of Business and the Viterbi School of Engineering.

notes.text: This program aims to develop future business leaders who will have a deep understanding of Artificial Intelligence technologies. Specifically,
notes.source_line: This program aims to develop future business leaders who will have a deep understanding of Artificial Intelligence technologies. Specifically,

notes.text: Students will have expertise in leveraging AI within organizations with a goal of enhancing societal value and understanding the ethical issues and risks in AI technologies.
notes.source_line: - Students will have expertise in leveraging AI within organizations with a goal of enhancing societal value and understanding the ethical issues and risks in AI technologies.

notes.text: Students will be able to conceptualize new products and services that leverage AI, with a sophisticated understanding of the state-of-the-art capabilities and practical limitations of what AI technologies can realistically achieve in a business context.
notes.source_line: - Students will be able to conceptualize new products and services that leverage AI, with a sophisticated understanding of the state-of-the-art capabilities and practical limitations of what AI technologies can realistically achieve in a business context.

notes.text: Students will be capable of forming effective teams with the expertise required to implement and scale AI technology solutions and formulating realistic timelines for AI products.
notes.source_line: - Students will be capable of forming effective teams with the expertise required to implement and scale AI technology solutions and formulating realistic timelines for AI products.

notes.text: Students will have expertise in analytics-driven decision making and strategy, able to discern the value of data assets in an organization and the effort required to realize the full potential of analytics in a business context.
notes.source_line: - Students will have expertise in analytics-driven decision making and strategy, able to discern the value of data assets in an organization and the effort required to realize the full potential of analytics in a business context.

notes.text: Students will understand and situate advanced AI technologies, make realistic assumptions about potential and risks for business ventures, and envision new markets through AI innovation.
notes.source_line: - Students will understand and situate advanced AI technologies, make realistic assumptions about potential and risks for business ventures, and envision new markets through AI innovation.

notes.text: The degree cannot be combined as an additional major in either Business Administration or Engineering. The degree is administered by the Marshall School of Business.
notes.source_line: The degree cannot be combined as an additional major in either Business Administration or Engineering. The degree is administered by the Marshall School of Business.

notes.text: A grade of C (2.0) or better is required for each of the Artificial Intelligence Introductory courses CSCI 113x , CSCI 114x and CSCI 170 . Courses with a grade of C- or below must be repeated; courses may be retaken only once. (Departmental approval is required in order to retake a course.)
